scope: Polyline simplification. The main checks one call of perpendicular-distance reduction against endpoints and an independent interpolation bound, and plots the original and reduced curves. Separate GNU 16 probes confirm incorrect radial-distance filtering and lost endpoints on consecutive perpendicular-distance calls at this pin; see the retained reproducers. The single-call example does not fix those upstream limitations.
known_limitations: radial_distance retains a near-duplicate point because its helper computes a dot product instead of squared distance.
Saved local flags in perpendicular_distance can lose corners and endpoints on consecutive calls; the demo calls it once.
